svg.aria-label: The measurement chain and spring–dashpot language of constant-force creep. The left panel identifies force control, gauge length and the load cell; the right combines immediate elasticity, delayed recovery and flow. The historical line connects the response models with the development of rheology. Original conceptual illustration.
